translations.M. Pickthall (English): He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But if there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.
translations.Yusuf Ali (English): He said: "Get ye down, both of you,- all together,(2646) from the Garden, with enmity one to another: but if, as is sure, there comes to you Guidance from Me, whosoever follows My Guidance, will not lose his way, nor fall(2647) into misery.
